description: Company profile from its own website: name, description, logo, social profiles, contact emails/phones, postal address, schema.org Organization JSON-LD, OpenGraph/Twitter cards, plus RDAP domain registration basics (registered, expires, registrar). SSRF-safe fetch of the public page. Returns JSON with: finalUrl, name, legalName, description, logo, socials, address, jsonLdTypes. Price: $0.03 USDC per successful call (x402, Base or Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: GET https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/company-profile
